title: Product Manager, AI Solutions
description: ABOUT CREDO AI The Credo AI Governance Platform operates as the trust layer for global enterprises focused on transforming their organizations with AI. It is powered by a knowledge graph that is updated by agents, enriched with global regulatory intelligence and curated business context, supported by Forward-Deployed Experts, giving enterprises a clear view of the risk profile behind every AI system. By making that risk visible, we enable teams to move quickly and confidently scale across systems to adopt compliant AI, faster and in a compliant manner. THE ROLE Our AI Governance Research team turns frontier AI research into product. What it builds is what sets Credo AI apart: governance intelligence that tells a company which rules apply to each AI system and agent, and AI-native features that do the governance work for them. You'll own the roadmap for these AI solutions and take each one from research prototype to a platform capability customers pay for. That includes our AI governance assistant for intake and risk mapping, our governance knowledge graph and regulatory intelligence, AI vendor and third-party risk, and the evaluations that prove our AI features work. You'll work with AI researchers and engineers who move fast and have strong opinions. Your job is to keep them pointed at customer problems, and to make sure what they build ships, sells and gets used. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the roadmap for our AI solutions, with clear monthly and quarterly outcomes. - Own product metrics for AI solutions, including assistant activation, completion rate, recommendation acceptance, time saved, AI quality/eval pass rates and feature retention. - Take prototypes through defined stages to platform capability: validated, beta, generally available. - Ship AI-powered governance intake: a user describes an AI use case, and the platform fills in the assessment, asks follow-up questions and assigns a risk tier. - Turn our knowledge graph into recommendations customers act on: which controls apply, which regulations matter, and what to do next. - Define how we measure AI quality: evals, acceptance thresholds, and when a feature is good enough to ship. - Partner with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on packaging, pricing, positioning and launch. - Talk to customers every month and bring their language back into the roadmap. WHAT HANDS-ON MEANS HERE - You prompt, test and break our AI features yourself before customers do. - You write eval criteria and review sample outputs, not just the PRD. - You build quick prototypes with AI coding tools to test an idea before engineering time is spent. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required: - 4+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one LLM-powered feature to production. - Practical understanding of how LLM products work: prompting, retrieval, agents, evals and their failure modes. - Experience turning research or prototypes into products customers pay for. - Clear, concise writing. You can explain a model's limits to an executive and to an engineer. - Comfort owning outcomes with a small team in a startup environment. Preferred: - Background in AI governance, risk, compliance or policy (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). - Experience with knowledge graphs, regulatory content or enterprise search. - Experience with vendor or third-party risk management. - Experience at a Series A–C company navigating ambiguity and resource constraints. - Preferred location: San Francisco, CA COMPENSATION The expected base salary range for this position is $160,000-180,000 USD. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position in the specified location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. LOCATION & REMOTE CULTURE While this is a remote role and we're a fully distributed team, we routinely meet up in-person. We support individual members to coordinate in-person coworking whenever possible, and organize company-wide offsites multiple times a year. At Credo AI we value diversity, equity, and inclusion as core principles in our work environment, and the development of our product offerings, and we have implemented initiatives to foster and support these values. Credo AI Benefits & Perks - Competitive Salary and Equity - Health: We offer health, dental, and vision coverage. We also offer an ergonomic benefit to cover the costs of equipment to help staff stay healthy while working, both in the office and at home. - Coworking: We will cover the cost of co-working spaces like WeWork and in-person meetups. - Unlimited PTO: Credo AI has unlimited time off to support our employees - Generous Parental Leave: We offer up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave. - 401(k) plan for employees (US only)

title: Senior Product Manager - Operations Automation & Enablement (OAE)
description: About the opportunity We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Senior Product Manager - Ops Automation & Enablement (OAE) with a passion for building the intelligence and systems behind world-class banking operations. This is a true builder’s role: you will lead the strategy, design, delivery, and enterprise-scale adoption of Agentic AI, hyperautomation, process mining, and internal tooling to reshape how complex, control-intensive Banking Operations are executed. You will work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders to ensure N26 can scale aggressively across markets and product offerings without proportional headcount growth—all while maintaining the strict regulatory and quality standards our customers expect. In this role, you will: Lead Enterprise Transformation & Agentic AI Adoption: Architect AI Workflows: Design, deploy, and govern E2E, multi-step Agentic AI solutions and automations that target high-volume processes, cross-team friction, and manual back-office tasks. AI Champion: Act as the primary AI Champion for Banking Operations: translating complex ML/AI concepts into practical, working systems rather than just talking about them. Change Management & Value Realization: Identify structural and behavioral barriers to adoption; design frameworks that embed new AI capabilities into day-to-day operations and team decision-making. End-to-End Operating Model & Process Intelligence: Process Mining Re-Engineering: Lead structured process capture, process mining, and workflow mapping. Evaluate opportunities to completely redesign end-to-end workflows rather than merely automating existing inefficiencies. Core CRM & Platform Integration: Partner with Conversational Banking and Platform owners to optimize Salesforce (our core case-management backbone) and integrate AI agents with our central architecture and AWS infrastructure. Operational Efficiency & ROI: Define and track clear metrics for every initiative (FTE impact, handling times, error rates, cost-per-unit, and time saved) to ensure high business value and ROI. Execution, Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Bridge Tech & Operations: Work directly with Banking Ops leads, Data Science, AI Enablement, and Engineering to turn operational pain points into clear product specs, PRDs, and prompt configurations. Regulatory Excellence: Collaborate with Data Protection, Legal, and Compliance teams to build resilient workflows that comply strictly with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal governance standards. Operational Readiness: Own product readiness for launches: ensuring changes in one pod do not disrupt downstream processes, control environments, or customer outcomes. What you need to be successful: Product Management Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, Process Engineering, or Operational Transformation, ideally in a fast-moving tech, digital, or fintech environment. AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience taking ML, RPA, or Agentic AI products from 0 to 1 (or significantly scaling them) with measurable, quantified operational savings. Hands-On & Technical Curiosity: Comfortable working with APIs, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks, and orchestration tools. You are hands-on enough to build/configure the first version yourself, but strategic enough to design the long-term vision. Process Improvement Mindset: Proven expertise in workflow mapping, failure demand analysis, and structured waste-reduction methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent). Regulated Environment Experience: Background in banking or fintech, navigating compliance, legal, and risk sign-offs in a control-heavy environment. Analytical & Data-Driven: Proficient in using data to model impact before building and measure results after (Power BI, SQL, or similar). Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of presenting complex trade-offs to senior leadership (EXCO/SteerCo) and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority. About You: Structured by default: You write things down, build systems, and actively retire processes that no longer serve the organization. AI-First Instinct: You inherently see how agents can augment human teams and make work faster, smarter, and cleaner. Pragmatic & Outcome-Focused: You care deeply about results, operational quality, and scalable growth, not just deploying shiny tools. What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. title: Senior Director, Digital Advertising
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. Veeam is seeking a Senior Director, Digital Advertising to lead our global digital marketing function and drive the strategy for how paid digital media drives demand generation and pipeline growth through a buyer’s journey from awareness, consideration, and conversion. You will lead a global team of digital experts and agency partners to develop audience-first media strategies that engage buying groups, from technical practitioners to executive decision makers. As the organization's paid digital leader, you will champion leading-edge best practices, emerging channels, and innovative media tactics to continuously improve performance and user experiences. Working cross-functionally with Campaign Management, Brand, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Analytics, MarTech and external partners, you will drive cohesive, data-driven digital programs that scale globally and deliver measurable business impact across Veeam segments and solutions. What You'll Do: Lead digital media strategy by integrating best-in-class practices, innovation, and data-driven optimization to increase pipeline contribution across digital tactics. Cultivate a growth culture that empowers a high-performing global team through continuous development and accountability. Own global digital media investment strategy optimizing across channels to maximize pipeline and revenue impact. Collaborate across global marketing functions and agency partners to scale integrated digital programs that accelerate demand generation and pipeline growth. title: Director, Applied AI
description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast. You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems, and treating evaluation and inference cost as core disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for a team of senior engineers while staying close to the code, shipping alongside the people you lead. What You'll Do You will ship code alongside your team, prototype alone to prove or kill an idea, and review code as a peer, setting how the team uses agentic coding tools with precise specifications and rigorous review. You will own delivery end-to-end, from problem framing through serving and on-call, including long-tail graph coverage and user memory for agents that separates user-supplied context from system-of-record data. You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — for challenges like sparse-company revenue estimation, entity resolution, and semantic intent modeling, deciding on measured evidence and stopping work that won't pay off. You will define what it takes to claim an agent's output is correct, not just that its run completed, building the evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that back those claims. You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions, since a model too expensive to run everywhere isn't a result. You will hire and grow machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, developing senior engineers into technical leaders. You will work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits to executives, including when a system isn't good enough to launch. What You Bring Must-Have: You have significant experience building production machine learning systems and leading the engineers who build them by shipping alongside them — demonstrated capability matters more than years. You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar. You stay hands-on today: shipping code, building prototypes independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review. You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference and experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting an evaluation bar with leakage-safe validation, calibration, and validated LLM judges. You have a record of cost and capacity decisions for model serving, such as moving a workload from a hosted model to a distilled or self-hosted one, with the savings measured, and you report results to executives with their limits stated, including recommending against a launch. Preferred: You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer. You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale. You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents. You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).   #LI-Hybrid #LI-VC1 Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training.
